changelog:
• 3-Launch Offline Grace Policy & Mandatory Update: Allows up to 3 offline launches when update or maintenance servers are unreachable; strictly enforces an unbypassable update dialog on the 4th launch.
• Unified Startup Security Check: Automatically validates maintenance mode, lock status, and minimum allowed version at launch.
• 100% English UI consistency across all dialogs, notifications, and update prompts.
• Bumped to v1.0.3 across Android, macOS & Web platforms.
